name: controls
description: Spend-authorization/approval control plane over wallets+payments: per-entity/per-agent spend caps, counterparty allowlists, tiered human-approval thresholds, segregation-of-duties, emergency freeze, and an immutable hash-chained money audit. CLI + MCP + serve triad. SQLite at ~/.hasna/controls/controls.db is authoritative unless HASNA_CONTROLS_DATABASE_URL is set, which selects the PostgreSQL backend.
